title: The named-roots test model answers session_status without the connection's capabilities, unlike the producer
outcome: Tests that drive real naming and the verification_record sender through ScriptedEngramControlTransport see the producer's status shape, so that the sender's capability gate is not silently tripped by the fixture itself.
acceptance: The named-roots model's own session_status answer (engram_named_root_test_transport.rs) has the producer's shape that old_and_new_bind_and_status_answers_both_parse pins, including `capabilities`, or a test that relies on the older shape names that explicitly. No existing test loses coverage. The model's other answers are unchanged.
